title: Micro-Grid Monitor
summary:
### Why it matters
Real-time energy dashboards that help apartment buildings visualize micro-grid output, outages, and savings.
one_pager:
# Micro-Grid Monitor

## Problem
Facility managers lack a simple view of how their micro-grid performs compared to the main grid.

## Solution
Deliver a live dashboard with health indicators, outage alerts, and kWh savings for every building.

## Demo Hooks

- Snapshot cards for solar, storage, and drawdown.
- CTA to download the sustainability report.
